summary: Customer requests Splunk HEC-compatible audit event stream and consolidated compliance evidence bundle for ISO27001/SOC2
description:
Issue summary: FinEdge Capital (enterprise customer) requests a production-ready audit event stream formatted for Splunk HEC ingestion plus a consolidated compliance evidence bundle covering the last 12 months for ISO27001 and SOC2 audits. Impact: Customer cannot complete their internal SOC2 readiness assessment without native SIEM integration and signed evidence artifacts (audit log schema, retention proof, access logs). Request details: 1) Provide a Splunk HEC-compatible event schema mapping (JSON examples) for all audit event types (auth/login, api.request.create, model.invoke, admin.policy.change, key.rotation). 2) Provide instructions and configuration for streaming events to a customer-owned HEC endpoint (mutual TLS + HEC token example). 3) Deliver a downloadable evidence bundle (signed PDFs and CSV manifests) that includes: export of relevant audit logs (last 12 months), S3 access logs or transfer manifest proving delivery, retention policy statement, KMS key rotation records, and the audit-logger service config and deployment timestamps. 4) Clarify log retention guarantees for private vs hosted deployments and provide signed statement for FinEdge's compliance team. Preferred delivery: initial sample events and mapping by 2026-03-12; full evidence bundle via secure S3 (pre-signed link) and a signed cover letter by 2026-03-17.

Requested fields/notes from customer: timestamps in RFC3339, event_type, request_id, customer_id (redwood token id), model_id, region, source_ip, outcome (success|error), error_code, user_agent, trace_id. They also want a sample grok/extract pattern and an example HEC ingestion curl command.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer requested a sample export on 2026-03-09 via email.
2) Support validated customer identity and entitlement to audit exports (enterprise contract) on 2026-03-10.
3) Support asked SRE to confirm retention and exportability of requested events.
4) Engineering to produce sample HEC payload and streaming instructions for customer to test ingestion.
logs_and_attachments: note: customer provided HEC endpoint and token stub in secure channel
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Maya Chen (Support): Acknowledged request and validated contract entitlements. Asked for HEC endpoint and preferred time window.
2026-03-10 11:02 - FinEdge (Customer): Provided HEC endpoint (redacted) and asked for sample events and a dry-run before full export. Emphasized need for signed evidence for auditor by 2026-03-17.
2026-03-10 14:22 - Alex Rivera (Support): Requested SRE confirm retention and KMS rotation records; flagged as P1 compliance delivery. Assigned to engineering for schema mapping.

2026-03-11 08:40 - Priya Nair (SRE): Confirmed audit-logger stores all requested event_types in prod:us-east-1 for 14 months; KMS rotation logs available in CloudKMS audit logs. Will prepare export script.

2026-03-11 15:10 - Daniel Park (Engineering): Drafted HEC payload examples and a streaming guide; asked whether customer requires mutual TLS or HEC token only. Uploaded sample to private S3 and shared link to support.
2026-03-12 09:05 - FinEdge (Customer): Confirms they require mutual TLS + HEC token. Requests proof of integrity (hash manifest) for the exported files.
investigation_notes: Checked audit-logger schema: event fields exist but some service names differ from customer's expected naming (e.g., 'model.invoke' vs 'inference.call'). Will include mapping table in deliverable.
Retention: prod:us-east-1 retention policy is 14 months for audit logs (meets 12-month request).
KMS rotation: last rotation event found on 2025-09-02; exportable signed log available from CloudKMS audit logs.
Data extraction approach: recommended export via internal bulk-export tool to encrypted S3, generate SHA256 manifest, then create signed PDF cover letter from Security team.
resolution_notes: Partial workaround provided: sample HEC payloads and cURL ingestion example delivered to customer on 2026-03-12 for dry-run.

Plan: SRE will produce full 12-month export to support S3 bucket encrypted and generate SHA256 manifest. Security will draft signed evidence letter and retention statement. Engineering will provide mapping table and grok patterns. Target full delivery 2026-03-17.
Follow-ups: create internal task INT-1124 to automate Splunk HEC streaming for enterprise customers and document runbook.
